name: Rawlinsons New Zealand Construction Handbook — Cost Benchmarks
description: Enables OCERP built-in validation rules that compare project cost-per-m² and elemental cost ratios against current Rawlinsons New Zealand Construction Handbook averages and apply Auckland/Wellington/Christchurch/regional NZ location factors.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
